title: OECD International Migration Outlook 2026 (released 12 Nov 2026): more than 9.2 lakh Indians acquired citizenship of OECD countries in 2020-24, up 41% from 6.5 lakh in 2015-19; Canada about 2.6 lakh (+150%); nearly 2.3 lakh in 2024 from the top five (Canada, US, Australia, UK, New Zealand); migration from India to the OECD fell 19% in 2024 to under 5 lakh. Separately MEA told the Rajya Sabha (Dec 2025) 8,96,843 gave up Indian citizenship in 2020-24 (sum of its yearly figures).
